items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: my dear friend, George Rifch, loaned me $150

ctx.x: And I was bailed out by an attorney. Someone got me an attorney, and then when we finally went to court, the case was, of course, dismissed. It cost me quite a lot of money to take care of that little item. And as soon as the case was dismissed, as I remarked earlier, my dear friend, George Rifch, loaned me $150 so I could go back to my job in Paris.
